scope: Fixed-parameter PIN photodiode grid and coupling to the selected TIA readout.
selection_policy: The full grid is evaluated with fixed inputs. Reference selection uses the stated physics, responsivity and timing checks.

pin.fixed: 850 nm, 300 K, 0.25 mm2 area, 1 uW incident light and the documented silicon/SRH model.
pin.selection: Reference candidates must pass the physics checks, have responsivity >=0.28 A/W and time-step-converged optical 2% settling <=10 ns. Among passing cases, select the lowest bias, then the higher responsivity.
pin.validation: Photon budget, terminal-current balance, field-model domain and transient endpoint checks. Consecutive time-step refinement requires <=2% change in rise and settling times for the 20.8 and 35.6 um cases. The selected reference has a DC/capacitance mesh check and a separate carrier-inventory capacitance crosscheck.
